Main Counter Card
nodes.description: Your Main Counter Card is the premium, credit-card-size NFC card built to live on your counter, front desk, barber station, salon desk, register, or checkout area.Once you order, we program it with your Google review link and tap-test it on iPhone and Android. When a customer taps their phone on the card, your Google review page opens instantly. No app, no typing, and no QR code needed.It costs a bit more than the Mini Bulk Cards because it's built to be seen and used every day for years: a heavier card, a cleaner finish, and a permanent spot on your counter, not something you hand out once and never see again. Credit-card size, built for counters and front desks Programmed with your Google review link after purchase One tap opens your Google review page, no app, no QR code required One-time price, no monthly fee Available in black or white Optional printed QR code backup if you want one This card makes leaving a review easier. It doesn't guarantee reviews or star ratings. What your customers write is always up to them.After ordering, we'll use the business name and Google review link from your order to program the card. Not sure of your link? Email sales@optiqservice.com with your order number.

nodes.title: Bulk Square Handout Cards
nodes.description: Mini Bulk Cards are the smaller, simpler version of our NFC review card, made to hand out, not display.Perfect for restaurants and busy local businesses: drop one in every takeout bag, tuck it inside the receipt, or hand it over with the bill while the visit is still fresh in your customer's mind.Because they're sold in bulk, they cost less per card than the Main Counter Card. The more you order, the lower your price per card. Each one is still programmed with your Google review link, so a single tap opens your review page. No app, no QR code needed. Great for restaurants, cafes, takeout spots, and any business that serves a lot of customers.

nodes.title: Bulk Restaurant Pack
nodes.description: Built for restaurants that want both: one premium card for the counter, plus a stack of mini cards to send home with customers.This pack includes 1 Main Counter Card for your register or host stand, and 50 Mini Bulk Cards to tuck into takeout bags, bills, and pickup orders. One-time price, no monthly fee.

nodes.title: Review Growth Plan
nodes.description: The Review Growth Plan is an optional monthly add-on for businesses that want a bit of ongoing help. It is not required to use your card. For $14.99/month, members get: Free link updates if your Google review link ever changes A monthly check-in on your Google reviews Priority support Discounts on future cards Cancel anytime.

nodes.title: Card Hosting
nodes.description: Keeps your Optiq card live. The $4.99/month hosting plan powers the tap-to-review redirect on every card you own: we host your review link, keep it pointed at your Google Business Profile, and update it free whenever your link changes.Hosting is required for your card to work. If you cancel, the tap-to-review redirect on your cards is switched off.
